title: Bird and Fortune - Subprime Crisis
summary: John Bird and John Fortune satirize the investment banking mindset in a mock interview about the subprime mortgage crisis. The sketch lampoons structured credit products and the banks' reassurances shortly before the crash.
why: HN points to it as a funny but accurate send-up of banker thinking, noting that comedians grasped the crisis before Lehman collapsed.

quote.text: at least comedians seemed to understand the crisis several months before Lehman crashed
